decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks have a dedicated page and fit the firm's core thermoforming consumables line, so with low carrying costs and adequate slack there is no shortfall that would trigger dropping them.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple consumable for dental laboratories, it is prominently presented, and it likely meets aspirations with minimal resource demands.

The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain, but it complements custom earmold and dental workflows and the large firm's slack allows it to be carried another year.
The intraoral contrast spray has its own page and supports the firm's digital scanning workflow strategy, so management keeps it despite early-stage uncertainty.
The custom earmold line sits within the firm's core hearing-care competence, and its only modest web presence does not indicate a performance shortfall large enough to drop it.
Custom hearing protection uses existing earmold manufacturing capabilities and serves a growing market, so slack allows it to be retained while results develop.
